Notes: PvP daily giver behind Antiques n' such, Borealis. KTCM (Illegal Notum Mining) is live via {givedaily KTCM}. Other options are listed but deferred — see ddogs/docs/dailies-design.md.

jobs.Text: What kind of work do you have?

bs.Text: Battlestation. Tip the scales for UBSL.

land.Text: Reclaiming the land — land control towers.

hello.Text: John Smith. Keep your voice down. I move Victory Point work for people who would rather not sit a full Battle Station, and a few dirtier jobs besides.

jobs.Text: Four cards on the table: Battlestation tip, Tarasque, illegal notum miners, or reclaiming land-control towers. Officially each track locks eighteen hours — Battlestation you could run three times. Pick one.

bs.Text: Battlestation for UBSL is not wired yet. Come back when that daily hooks the 425-point update. Try the notum miners if you want something live.

tara.Text: Tarasque is not on our board yet — Camelot spawn and the daily target still need content. Try the notum miners.

miners.Text: Kill three Rogue Notum Miners dealing in illegal notum. Field is Stret West Notum Ore for now until the real Notum Mining Area is up. A Ganking Uncle Pumpkin-Head can show every run.{givedaily KTCM}

land.Text: Reclaiming the Land needs land-control tower targeting we do not have yet. Try the notum miners.

done.Text: Good work. Here is your pay.{completequest KTCM}
